Getting started

How KickMaths works.

Choose a practice year, answer maths questions to take shots, and use the learning record to plan what comes next.

From the first warm-up to later recall.

Check the starting point

A short warm-up samples the chosen year. Coach checks smaller supporting skills when the answers show a gap.

Practise with clear working

Answer maths questions to take a shot. Use Coach’s written steps when an idea needs explaining. Helped answers do not earn XP.

Return to the skills that need work

Correct independent answers, mistakes and later recall build an individual learning record. Parents and teachers can inspect it in the game.

Maths earns player upgrades.

Independent answers on new or due questions can earn XP in eligible Coach matches and drills. Completing the first game gives 10 starter credits. Every 10 career XP earns another credit. Spend credits on player styles and colours in the Shop; those items only become available in Customise after purchase.

Learning progress and game levels are separate.

XP levels, medals and club offers make the football game enjoyable. A skill becomes secure through independent answers, varied practice and recall over time. The Parent report explains its remaining requirements, while year promotion also includes practical checks.

Find the right settings.

Dyslexia-friendly mode changes the reading layout. Reduced motion has its own setting. Practice can be untimed, and written calculations receive additional working time in timed matches.
